name: Kushigata Youko
source:
Born on September 10, 1989.
Member of the Guitar club. She has distinctive blunt bangs and narrow eyes. She is strict with those she doesn't approve of, and has a fierce and strong personality. She likes folk songs. She also seems to dislike [url=/c136075]Hijiri Ayaka[/url], who is active as a popular idol, calling her "Parents' Seven Lights," but she believes that Ayaka's feelings towards folk songs and guitars are genuine.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
